kitDescription: Ade: Agent Bunny (SR/Iron/Supporter/Burst II, cd 20s, 6 ammo, 141 reload frames, 60 charge frames, normal 69.04 / charge 250) is a full-charge-cadence team buffer with a self-ramp. Every full-charge hit in effective range grants ALL allies +15.2% of HER OWN ATK as a flat ATK add (caster-sourced) for 5s (S1) and +18.36% Pierce Damage for 5s (S2). Each full charge also stacks Spy Lens on herself (Minimum Effective Range +4.44%, up to 10, 5s) — an inert stat in-engine, but the STACK COUNT is load-bearing: at max stacks she permanently gains Pierce and +16% ATK continuously (S2), which turns her own team-wide Pierce Damage buffs into a self-feed. Her Burst II grants herself +55.56% Minimum Effective Range (inert) and all allies +55.04% Attack Damage and +10.13% Pierce Damage for 10s. Net: a ramping supporter whose personal damage only comes online after 10 full charges (~16s), and whose Pierce Damage buffs are inert on non-Pierce teammates.

kitLineClassification.line: ATK ▲ 15.2% of the skill user's ATK for 5 sec (allies, on full-charge landing)
kitLineClassification.evidence: A1: one flat value (≈15159.57 = 0.152 × staticAtk 99734) uniform across all 4 allies, 5s, once per shot (count = shots×4); CF generic atkPct stores raw 15.2 AND moves ada's total (discriminates); CF shotFired→burstCast collapses cadence 420→48 (discriminates). S6 blind converged BYTE-IDENTICALLY.

kitLineClassification.line: Spy Lens: Minimum Effective Range ▲ 4.44%, stacks up to 10, 5 sec (self)
kitLineClassification.encoding: unmodeled.skill1 verbatim (inert STAT — no range StatKey); STACK COUNT modeled via hitCount:10 step on skill2[1]
kitLineClassification.evidence: A2 asserts the verbatim line is present in unmodeled.skill1. The load-bearing half (the count) IS modeled and is asserted by A4. Split-classification is correct: the stat is unmodelable, the counter is modeled.

kitLineClassification.line: Pierce Damage ▲ 18.36% for 5 sec (allies, on full-charge landing)
kitLineClassification.evidence: A3: raw magnitude, 5s, all 4 allies, once per shot; CF removal deletes the buff; INERTNESS — zeroing leaves liter/ada/helm BYTE-IDENTICAL and moves only ade (the sole pierce-tagged unit), matching engine fact (b) exactly. S6 converged identically.

kitLineClassification.line: Gains Pierce, continuous (self, only at max Spy Lens stacks)
kitLineClassification.encoding: hitCount:10 → self → gainPierce, NO durationSec ⇒ pierceUntilFrame → ∞
kitLineClassification.evidence: Engine fact (c): gainPierce is a real step-gateable primitive added 2026-07-20 for THIS unit precisely so Pierce can be gated on a stack threshold. A4 asserts the structural block, asserts NO top-level hasPierce, and discriminates twice: CF no-gainPierce drops ade total −12.9% (the pierce self-feed is load-bearing) and CF top-level hasPierce (always-on) moves ade +1.0% (over-credits the first ~16s).

kitLineClassification.line: ATK ▲ 16% continuously (self, only at max Spy Lens stacks)
kitLineClassification.encoding: hitCount:10 → self → buff atkPct 16, NO durationSec ⇒ continuous (expiresFrame null)
kitLineClassification.evidence: A4: first lands on the 10th shot (frame 955 / 15.9s), self-only, expiresFrame null; CF always-on (trigger→shotFired) lands it on the 1st shot (discriminates the gate). 'continuously' in the prose is read literally — no durationSec. Engine fact (d) confirms hitCount:10 first fires on shot 10 at hitsPerShot 1 and that re-application merely refreshes.

B1 asserts verbatim presence. No StatKey exists for minimum effective range; nothing in the engine consumes range (noRange is force-set). Genuinely unmodelable, correctly disclosed rather than silently dropped.

B2: kit magnitude, 10s, all 4 allies, once per burstCast (count = bursts×4); structural trigger asserted as burstCast — NOT fullBurstEnter, which S2b named as the top shared-prior-misread candidate; CF removal deletes the buff. S6 converged identically.

B3: kit magnitude, 10s, all 4 allies, once per burstCast; CF removal deletes; INERTNESS — zeroing ONLY the 10.13 leaves non-pierce teammates byte-identical and moves only ade. This is the S2b-REQUIRED strengthening, adopted.

s5PristineRuling.result: 2 passed / 22 failed / 3 skipped (27) UNMODIFIED vs shipped
s5PristineRuling.ruling: ALL 22 REDs are RECON_ERROR (test artifact). ZERO are REAL-GOTCHA.

s5PristineRuling.adaptedResult: 24 passed / 3 skipped (27), 0 failed vs shipped — pristine preserved, only the 6 unverifiable engine/harness assumptions corrected, assertion INTENT unchanged. The 3 skips = the 2 unmodelable Min-Eff-Range GAPs + 1 conservative engine-gated pierce skip already covered by driver A3/A4.
s5PristineRuling.conclusion: An INDEPENDENT assertion set, written blind from prose, goes fully green against the shipped override once its guesses about engine internals are corrected. That is cross-family corroboration of the override, not of the driver's test.

s6DiffRuling.item: Spy-Lens stack gate: S6 resource pool spyLens + resourceGate{min:10} vs driver hitCount:10
s6DiffRuling.ruling: NO functional divergence — both gates open on the 10th full-charge hit. hitCount is the engine's native counter primitive (fact (d)); the resource pool is a hand-rolled equivalent. Driver's choice is the leaner of two correct encodings. Both families independently flagged the same refresh-all-vs-per-stack-expiry ambiguity as the dominant uncertainty, which is itself corroboration of ⚑2's scope.

s6DiffRuling.item: Pierce step-gate: S6 top-level hasPierce:true (t=0) vs driver gainPierce at hitCount:10
s6DiffRuling.ruling: The prose gates Pierce on max Spy Lens stacks. S6 encoded it unconditionally and its OWN caveat admits this 'over-credits her benefit from her S2/burst Pierce Damage ▲ buffs early… the ramp cannot be expressed', on the mistaken belief that no resource-gated form existed. gainPierce (fact (c)) IS that form, added specifically for this unit. Driver holds Pierce off for the first 10 shots (~16s, ≈9% of fight) — measured at +1.0% ade total when wrongly made always-on (driver A4 CF). Driver is more faithful; not a gotcha.

s6DiffRuling.item: atkPct 16 duration: S6 durationSec 5 (refreshed while gated) vs driver continuous (no durationSec)
s6DiffRuling.ruling: Prose reads 'ATK ▲ 16% continuously'. Driver's no-durationSec matches the word literally; S6's 5s-refresh is functionally near-equivalent while she keeps firing but would lapse during a long reload/idle gap the prose does not license. Minor, driver correct.

convergenceSummary: S6 blind converged BYTE-IDENTICALLY on 3 of the 4 damage-bearing blocks (S1 casterAtkPct 15.2/5s/allies; S2 pierceDamagePct 18.36/5s/allies; burst attackDamagePct 55.04 + pierceDamagePct 10.13/10s/allies) and on BOTH unmodeled Min-Eff-Range lines verbatim, from prose alone with leakDetected:null. The only two diffs are one encoding-equivalent gate and one place where the driver is strictly MORE faithful. Cross-family corroboration: CONFIRMED.

fireRateCheck.detail: skill1[0] + skill2[0] fire on shotFired = once per full charge — an SR at chargeFrames 60 always fires full charge and the engine force-sets noRange (fact (e)), so the prose's 'landing Full Charge within effective range' is satisfied on every shot; A1/A3 assert count = shots×4 (105 shots, 420 buffApply events) and the shotFired→burstCast CF collapses it to 48 (the cadence is discriminated, not assumed). skill2[1] fires once at hitCount:10 = the 10th shot, frame 955 / 15.9s, consistent with hitsPerShot 1 and fact (d); duration-less so it never re-lapses. burst[0] fires once per burstCast (12 casts, 48 events) with ade the SOLE B2 in liter/ade/ada/helm so she casts every FB cycle — burst eligibility verified, not assumed. Cadences are mutually consistent with ammo 6 / reload 141f / charge 60f: no block fires faster or slower than the prose implies.

discriminationCheck.detail: Every FAITHFUL line is GREEN vs shipped AND RED vs its nearest-wrong counterfactual. S1 casterAtkPct: nearest-wrong generic atkPct (stores raw 15.2, moves ada) — CF RED; nearest-wrong trigger burstCast — CF RED (420→48). S2 pierceDamagePct 18.36: CF removal RED, plus a POSITIVE inertness discriminator (non-pierce teammates byte-identical). gainPierce: two CFs — absent (−12.9% ade) and always-on (+1.0% ade) — both RED, bracketing the gate from both sides. atkPct 16: CF trigger→shotFired lands it on shot 1 — RED. Burst attackDamagePct 55.04: structural burstCast asserted against the fullBurstEnter misread S2b named as the top shared-prior risk — RED under substitution; CF removal RED. Burst pierceDamagePct 10.13: CF removal RED + isolated inertness. No FAITHFUL assertion is vacuous or tautological; the two DOCUMENTED_GAPs are asserted as verbatim-presence-in-unmodeled, which is the only discriminating check available for an inert stat.

preOpAdoption.status: ADOPTED — driver A3 and B3 each carry an INERTNESS assertion (zeroing leaves liter/ada/helm byte-identical, moves only ade)
preOpAdoption.s2bMisreads: S2b labeled 'Gains Pierce' as FIX and Spy Lens as needing a resourceGate, both on the assumption the engine lacked the needed primitives. It HAS both (gainPierce, hitCount). The driver used them. S2b's dispositions on all 5 other lines (FAITHFUL/UNMODELED) match this judgment.

flags.claim: shotFired is used as the proxy for 'landing a Full Charge attack on a target within the effective range'
flags.estimate: In-sim exact (SR always full-charges at chargeFrames 60; engine force-sets noRange ⇒ every shot satisfies the clause). Divergence vs a real fight is bounded by real-fight uncharged/out-of-range shots; expected ≤5% of shots on a stationary partless boss, ≈0 with disciplined play. Buff uptime is refresh-dominated (5s duration vs sub-second shot cadence), so even a 10% miss rate would move ally uptime <1%.
flags.recipe: Record a partless-boss run with ade in slot; count full-charge shot popups vs total shot popups from the ammo counter + popup colour; compare the ratio to the sim's shotFired count over the same window. Deviation >5% reopens the proxy.

flags.claim: Spy-Lens ramp shape: (i) 10 stacks are reached on the 10th full charge, and (ii) the stack set refreshes wholesale rather than expiring per-stack at 5s each
flags.estimate: Under refresh-all (both families' reading) the gate opens at frame 955 / 15.9s and never closes — ade's Pierce + atkPct 16 are live for ~91% of a 3:00 fight. Under strict per-stack 5s expiry the gate would still open at the same shot (her cadence is well under 5s/shot) but would drop out during reloads (141 frames = 2.35s, under 5s ⇒ still no drop) — so the two readings likely coincide in practice; the divergence only appears if her shot cadence ever exceeds 5s. Estimated total-damage impact of the wrong reading: <1% on this fixture.
flags.recipe: Two probes: (a) confirm 10 stacks land on the 10th charge via the Spy Lens stack icon count against the shot counter; (b) force a >5s firing gap (deliberate idle after reload) and check whether the stack display drops to 0 (refresh-all) or decays stepwise (per-stack). Both families named this the dominant uncertainty independently.

flags.claim: SR cadence tuple (ammo 6, reloadFrames 141, chargeFrames 60, hitsPerShot 1) drives the 105-shot / 10th-shot-at-frame-955 timeline
flags.estimate: Datamined nominal values; the 10th-shot step at 15.9s follows directly. A ±10% error in reload or charge frames shifts the gate open time by ~±1.6s ≈ ±0.9% of fight, i.e. sub-1% on ade's total.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read on a recording: time 10 full charges from t0 and compare to 15.9s. Note the nominal-vs-effective rule — a datamined rate is nominal and the game fires on 60fps frame boundaries; chargeFrames 60 and reloadFrames 141 are already frame-quantized, so no ceil correction applies here.

faithfulnessRationale: 8 kit lines total: 6 FAITHFUL, 2 DOCUMENTED_GAP (both genuinely unmodelable — no Minimum Effective Range StatKey exists — and both disclosed verbatim in `unmodeled`, with the load-bearing half of the Spy Lens line, the stack COUNT, actually modeled). 0 SILENT_DROP, 0 REAL-GOTCHA of any tier, 0 RECON_ERROR attributable to the override. Score = FAITHFUL / (total − legitimately-unmodelable) = 6/6 = 1.0.
verdictBasis: Zero silent drops — every kit line is either modeled or disclosed verbatim in `unmodeled`.
Zero engine-core defects — no invented mechanics, no fudged magnitudes; every number is kit-datamined at lvl10.
Cross-family corroboration CONFIRMED — S6 blind (leakDetected:null) reproduced 3 of 4 damage-bearing blocks byte-identically and both unmodeled lines verbatim from prose alone.
All 22 pristine-S5 REDs adjudicated RECON_ERROR; the ADAPTED blind test (intent preserved) goes 24/0/3 against the shipped override.
Fire-rate check PASS; discrimination check PASS — every FAITHFUL line is RED against its nearest-wrong counterfactual, including the fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast shared-prior trap.
The only fidelity-class diff found anywhere in the gauntlet (hasPierce vs gainPierce) resolves IN THE DRIVER'S FAVOUR, with S6's own caveat conceding the point.
S2b's required strengthening (pierce-buff inertness on non-pierce teammates) was adopted in both A3 and B3.
residualRisk: Both flagged uncertainties (⚑1 proxy, ⚑2 stack-expiry semantics) are estimated at <1% total-damage impact on this fixture and both are measurable by the recipes above; neither is load-bearing for the GO. ⚑2 is tier-HIGH by convention (it is the dominant open question both families named) but its practical impact is bounded low because her shot cadence never exceeds the 5s stack window.
